ex: Den will sie doch und soll ihn haben.
This is what they want and what they should have.
Laura hat mir ihr neues Auto gezeigt.
Laura showed me her new car.

s.d: its (when the owning object/article/thing/animal etc., referred to, is feminine)
ex: die Sonne und ihre Wärme
the sun and its warmth
Die Kinder spielen mit ihrem Hund.
The kids are playing with their dog.

s.d: your (that belongs to you (when formally or politely addressing one or more people))
ex: Wo ist Ihr Wagen, Frau Wagner?
Where is your car, Mrs. Wagner?

s.d: from her; on her behalf; as for her
from them; on their behalf; as for them
ex: Die anderen haben ihrerseits genau den gleichen Fehler gemacht.
The others, in turn (to them), made exactly the same mistake.

s.d: because of her, for her sake
ex: Das ist alles ihretwegen passiert.
All of this happened because of her.

s.d: because of them, for their sake
ex: Das ist alles ihretwegen passiert.
All of this happened because of them.

s.d: as far as she is concerned (she doesn't mind if); for all she cares
ex: Ihretwegen kannst du mitkommen.
As far as she is concerned, you can come with us.

s.d: as far as they are concerned (they don't mind if); for all they care
ex: Ihretwegen kannst du mitkommen.
As far as they are concerned, you can come with us.
